rule: Every row links an official operator / agency page. Prices are the operator's published adult price; 'For 2 adults' is that price x 2 (or the published per-vehicle price where the fee is per vehicle). Values not published on an official page are blank and flagged.
travel_rule: The brief asks for activities within 1 hour of the hotel. No official door-to-door transit-time matrix could be retrieved, so the travel column states only what an official source supports (same-address, on-Strip corridor, or a published distance/road) and is otherwise marked unverified. Nothing is estimated.

rows.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area — 13-mile Scenic Drive
rows.area: West of the Strip, off W. Charleston Blvd (SR 159)

hours.v: Visitor Center & Elements Gift Shop: daily 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
hours.exceptions: TIMED-ENTRY RESERVATION REQUIRED for vehicle entry to the Scenic Drive 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, October 1 – May 31. This covers the entire Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 window.

price_2.note: Fee is per vehicle, so two adults in one car pay $20 total. Arriving by commercial vehicle / taxi / rideshare: $20 per vehicle + $5 per person = $30 for two. Pedestrian $5 pp; bicycle $8 per bicycle.

travel.v: Official: 'just a few miles west of Las Vegas'. No official transit route serves the Scenic Drive.
travel.note: Practical access is by car or commercial tour. Not reachable on the RTC Strip services.

rows.note: 26 hikes/trails. America the Beautiful annual pass is $80 for U.S. citizens/residents but $250 for non-U.S. residents — relevant if you are visiting from outside the U.S. The $50 Red Rock annual pass is the cheaper local option.

rows.name: Hoover Dam — tours & visitor center
rows.area: Boulder City, NV — southeast of the Strip

hours.v: Dam open to the public daily 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (PST). Visitor Center and tours daily 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
hours.exceptions: The official page begins to list holiday exceptions ('except Th…') but the full exception list was cut off in the retrieved text — confirm before a holiday visit. Guided Dam Tour tickets are ON-SITE ONLY and must be bought in person.

price_adult.v: Guided Dam Tour $40 pp · Guided Powerplant Tour $25 pp · Self-guided Visitor Center $15 pp

price_2.note: Children 3 and under free. Powerplant and Visitor Center tickets are upgradeable on-site.

booking.v: Powerplant and Visitor Center tickets sell online via the official ticketing link; the Guided Dam Tour is in-person only.

travel.note: No official travel-time figure retrieved. Not served by RTC Strip routes.

social.note: Agency-level (Bureau of Reclamation) accounts linked from the official Hoover Dam pages. The dam's own page links Facebook (facebook.com/theHooverDam), not a dam-specific YouTube/Instagram.

rows.note: America the Beautiful / Interagency passes are NOT accepted at Hoover Dam — it is self-funded.

rows.name: Valley of Fire State Park
rows.area: 29450 Valley of Fire Rd, Overton, NV 89040 — northeast of Las Vegas

hours.v: Park open daily, sunrise to sunset, 365 days a year. Visitor Center daily 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM.
hours.exceptions: Annual maintenance closure Dec 1–14 (outside your window). Annual trail closures May 15 – Sep 30 (outside your window — so the Fire Wave, White Domes and Pastel Canyon trails ARE open in Feb/Mar). Park office Mon–Fri 9–4, closed state holidays. A separate notice says the WEST ENTRANCE is open only until November 30, 2026 — re-check entrance status for 2027.

price_2.note: Per-vehicle day-use fee. Two adults in one non-Nevada-plated vehicle (e.g. a rental) pay $15 total. No reservation required for day use.

booking.v: No day-use reservation needed. Camping by reservation via ReserveNevada.

travel.note: No official travel-time figure retrieved; the park is near Overton, well outside the valley. Treat as a full-day drive, not a 1-hour hop.

rows.note: Official warning: taking Uber/Lyft can leave you STRANDED — a return ride is often impossible. A car or an organised tour is effectively required. Drones prohibited.

rows.name: The Neon Museum / Neon Boneyard
rows.area: 770 Las Vegas Blvd N, Las Vegas, NV 89101 — downtown, north end of the Strip corridor

hours.v: SEPT–MAY: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM daily, last entry 10:00 PM (this is the schedule for your Feb/Mar 2027 dates)
hours.exceptions: JUN–AUG: 8:00 PM – midnight, last entry 11:00 PM. Box office closes 1 hour before posted closing. Outdoor collection: tours/GA can be cancelled for lightning, high wind, poor air quality or heat (guided tours stop above 100°F, GA closes above 105°F, museum closes above 110°F). From January 1, 2027, arriving earlier or later than your selected ticket time may incur an extra charge.

price_2.note: Ticket prices were not exposed on the retrieved official visit page.

booking.v: Advance purchase on the official site is recommended to guarantee a preferred time.

travel.v: On the Las Vegas Blvd corridor — the RTC Deuce runs the length of Las Vegas Blvd between the South Strip Transit Terminal and downtown.

social.note: Both linked from the official Neon Museum site navigation.

rows.note: Photography: personal snapshots on phones/tablets ONLY. No cameras, tripods or selfie sticks — they must be left in a vehicle or checked at the front desk.

rows.name: The Mob Museum (National Museum of Organized Crime & Law Enforcement)
rows.area: 300 Stewart Avenue, Las Vegas, NV 89101 — downtown

hours.v: Museum daily 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM. The Underground speakeasy: Sun–Thu 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM; Fri–Sat 11:00 AM – midnight.
hours.exceptions: Hours subject to change; the museum publishes a separate early-closures page. Online reservations strongly encouraged; some discounts are online-only.

price_adult.v: General Admission $37.95 · Deluxe Pass $49.95 · Premier Pass $54.95 (per adult)

price_2.note: Online-only Morning (9–11 AM) or Evening (5–9 PM) arrival drops Premier to $47.95 pp = $95.90 for two. All passes include entry to The Underground. Children 10 & under free. Prices were read on the official admission portal with a November 2026 date selected — 2027 pricing may differ.

travel.v: Downtown, near the RTC Bonneville Transit Center area that the Deuce serves.

rows.note: Housed in the actual 1933 federal courthouse. Bundled with SlotZilla Zoomline for $88 on the Fremont Street Experience site (offer applies to Zoomline only).

rows.name: High Roller Observation Wheel (The LINQ)

hours.v: Live status on the official page showed 'Opens 12:30 PM'. Ticket windows are published as 'Daily 12 PM – 5 PM' (daytime) and 'Anytime, daily 12 PM – close'.
hours.exceptions: The 12:30 PM opening status and the 12 PM ticket window disagree on the same official page — flagged. Happy Half Hour cabins are 21+ only.

price_adult.v: Adult daytime (12 PM – 5:59 PM) $23.50 · Adult anytime (from 6 PM) $34.75 · Happy Half Hour (21+) $60

price_2.note: All plus taxes and fees. Children 3 & under free; youth 4–12 $8.50 daytime / $17.50 anytime. Seniors 65+ get $5 off Sun–Thu 12–5 PM at the box office.

booking.v: Official page links Ticketmaster; box office also sells.

travel.v: Center Strip, on the Las Vegas Blvd corridor served by the Deuce; also near a Las Vegas Monorail station.

social.note: Caesars Entertainment property accounts verified on caesars.com. No High-Roller-specific account was confirmed.

rows.note: 550 ft, largest observation wheel in North America; 28 cabins; one revolution takes 30 minutes (allow ~1 hour total). Caesars Rewards Gold/Platinum members can buy one ticket and get one free (limit 2 tickets/month) — a genuine 2-for-1 for a couple. Individual outside drinks allowed; no glass, coolers or cases.

rows.name: SlotZilla Zipline — Fremont Street Experience
rows.area: Fremont Street Experience, downtown Las Vegas

hours.exceptions: Operating hours were not exposed on the retrieved official SlotZilla page; pricing is split Mon–Thu vs Fri–Sun.

price_adult.v: Zip Line: Mon–Thu from $49, Fri–Sun from $55. Zoom Line: Mon–Thu from $69, Fri–Sun from $75.

price_2.note: All 'starting at' prices, plus fees. Mob Museum + SlotZilla bundle $88 (Zoomline only), advertised Mon–Sun.

travel.v: Downtown terminus of the RTC Deuce corridor along Las Vegas Blvd.

social.note: Official 'SlotZilla Hall of Famers' videos linked directly from the operator's own page (Katy Perry; Vampire Diaries; Spruce The Goose x The Aviator).

rows.note: Zip Line: seated, launch 77 ft, 3 blocks, rider 50–300 lbs. Zoom Line: belly-down, launch 11 stories, 5 blocks, rider 80–300 lbs. Max height 6'8" for either. ADA elevators available.

rows.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens

hours.exceptions: Daily opening hours were not exposed on the retrieved official page. The SEASONAL CALENDAR is verified (see note).

price_2.note: Admission price is not stated on the official page; do not assume free without confirming.

travel.v: Center Strip on the Las Vegas Blvd Deuce corridor; adjacent to a Las Vegas Monorail station.

rows.note: VERIFIED 2027 calendar: Lunar New Year display Jan 9 – Mar 6, 2027. DARK (closed) Mar 7 – Mar 12, 2027. Spring display Mar 13 – May 15, 2027. So a Feb 15–22 stay sees the Lunar New Year installation; a Mar 7–12 visit sees nothing. 14,000 sq ft. The Garden Table dining (brunch $135 pp / dinner $210 pp) runs only through Jan 2 — NOT available in your window.

rows.name: Sphere — immersive shows & concerts
rows.area: Sphere, off-Strip east near The Venetian

hours.exceptions: Show times are per-event. The official site states event content, dates, times, prices and availability are subject to change.

price_2.note: No ticket prices published on the official homepage; pricing sits on the per-event Ticketmaster pages.

booking.v: Official site links Ticketmaster per show; group pricing for 9+.

rows.note: Programming advertised at the time of check included The Wizard of Oz at Sphere (with new 4D effects), P!NK, RUSH, Eagles, Backstreet Boys, John Mayer, Carín León and Metallica. NO February/March 2027 date was confirmed — this must be re-checked against the official shows page before it goes in an itinerary.
